ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast distribution with a macro-level ratio of high-intensity white to low-intensity black pixels estimated at 60:40 across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous high-intensity white fields occupy the central-medial regions of both lobes; low-intensity black pigmentation dominates the trailing edge and extends into the white fields as radial streaks and dense mottling.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with a calculated angle of approximately 115 degrees; notch depth is clearly defined relative to the lobe heights.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, jagged serrations distributed along the entire trailing edge boundary, featuring pixel-amplitude variations of 5-15 pixels in peak-to-valley depth.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Overall convex sweep along the trailing edge leading to distal tips that exhibit an upward and outward curvature (convexity).

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense, high-contrast clusters of circular pixel formations located at the extreme lateral tips of both the left and right lobes, consistent with barnacle colonization.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Distinct dark linear pixel disruptions visible on the left lobe (multiple vertical streaks) and the right lobe (oblique rake-like marks) cutting across the high-intensity fields.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant physical texturing and irregular bulbous protrusions at both distal lobe tips caused by epibiotic growth and associated scarring.
other_distinctive_markers: A prominent, isolated dark linear mark positioned in the upper-medial region of the right lobe, distinct from the primary pigmentation streaks.
